bullets.text: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the platform gap at Adambakkam station, and the office should monitor progress for commuter safety.
Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran is among four police officers transferred by the home secretary, and the office should note the local leadership change.
Avadi and Tambaram police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized ganja and other narcotics, and the office should acknowledge the anti-drug enforcement action.
University of Madras approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to set up an AI lab, and the office should track this academic industry partnership.
LiveX launched humanlike AI hosts powered by NVIDIA technology to provide conversational assistance in public venues, and the office should watch these deployments.

stories.title: Train-platform gap yet to be rectified at Adambakkam
takeaways: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix platform gaps at Adambakkam station.
Commuter safety concerns persist until the railway platform modifications are completed.

stories.title: Avadi, Tambaram police destroy over 1.7 tonnes of ganja
takeaways: Avadi and Tambaram City Police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of confiscated ganja and various synthetic narcotics.
The public destruction drive demonstrates aggressive law enforcement action against regional drug trafficking networks.

The technology highlights global innovations in practical AI integration that can inspire local governance strategies.
